title: Accepted asynchronous submission reaches a failed terminal state

source.normalization: The terminal response is based on evidence/zoo/demo.job-failure.json; job IDs and timestamps are templated.

must: Expose an accepted job and keep submission evidence separate from later status responses.
must_not: Predict failure merely because this test process is known to fail.

must: Stop polling at the failed terminal state.
Expose the exact server message and retain the complete raw status document.
Keep HTTP retrieval success separate from process-job failure.
must_not: Fetch a successful results document when no results relation is advertised.
Replace the server message with a guessed input error.
Automatically re-submit the non-idempotent execution request.
